sentences.text:
This appeal by the appellant/claimant under section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act is arising out of the award dated 27.10.2015 passed by 1st Additional Member, MACT, District Dewas in Claim Case No.298/2014.
2.
The date of accident, death of the deceased, negligence and the issue of liability is not in dispute.
The findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal in this regard are not in dispute.
As per the findings of the Tribunal in this, the death of the deceased is proved due to the said accident.
The age of 60 years of the deceased has also not been disputed and therefore proved.
Hence, the Tribunal has awarded a total compensation of Rs.2,87,000/- along with interest.

3. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the Tribunal has committed an error in not awarding just and proper amount of compensation NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:6169 2 MA-250-2016 in the case as the amount awarded by the Tribunal is on the lower side.
The learned trial Court has assumed the income of the deceased as Rs.3000/- per month, whereas, as per the minimum Wages Act it should not be less then Rs.5848/- per month.
The Tribunal has committed error in granting meager amount under various heads i.e. no future prospects has been considered.
In view of the income, the loss of dependency is on lower side and nothing was awarded under conventional heads.
Similarly, there is nothing under loss of estate also.
Hence, prays for just and proper amount of compensation in the matter.

Smt. Mankunwarbai vs Preetamsingh @ Raja on 7 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31032669/
1 4.

On the other hand, learned counsel for the Insurance Company contends that the Claims Tribunal has rightly awarded the amount of compensation in the matter which does not call for any interference by this Court.

5. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and on perusal of the record, more particularly the age of 60 years of the deceased, the income of the deceased should be in view of the minimum wages act and therefore, it would be appropriate to accept the suggestion of the appellant.
Hence, the income of the deceased is treated as Rs.5845/ per month.
Since, the age of the deceased is proved as 60 years, future prospects should be fixed as 10%.
Further, in view of the hike in income, other heads shall be enhanced as per the income.
Therefore, in the considered opinion of this Court, the amount of compensation deserves to be enhanced and the same is enhanced as under:

Heads Amount (Awarded by Tribunal) Enhanced by this Court NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:6169 3 MA-250-2016 A. Income :3000x12x1/2/x1/2 :5845x12+(10%) =Rs.1,62,000/- =Rs.77.154/-
 Future Prospevts @ :Nil   A.Less Personal Expense: 1/2 (Rs.18,000) 
 B. Dependency : 1/2 (Rs.18,000) 
 Multiplier : 9   C. Loss of Dependency : Rs.1,62,000/-(18000x  D. Loss of Consossium : Rs.1,00,000/- 
 E .

Conventional Heads :NIL   F. Funeral Expenses :Rs.25,000/- 
 G.Loss of Estate :NiL   Total (C+D+F) : Rs.2,87,000/- 
 MACT Award :Rs.2,87,000/
 Enhanced amount :Rs.6,12,924-R  =Rs.3,2 6.
Thus, the just and proper amount of compensation in the instant case is Rs.6,12,924/- as against the Award of the Claims Tribunal of Rs.2,87,000/-.

Accordingly, the appellant/claimant are entitled to an additional sum of (Rs.6,12,924-2,87,000) =
Rs.3,25,924/- over and above the amount, which has been awarded by the Claims Tribunal.
Smt. Mankunwarbai vs Preetamsingh @ Raja on 7 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31032669/
2 7.
In the result, this miscellaneous appeal is partly allowed.
The claimants are entitled to get total amount of compensation i.e. Rs.2,87,000/- + Rs.3,25,924/- =6,12,924/-.

The enhanced amount i.e.
Rs.3,25,924/- shall carry interest as fixed by the learned Claims Tribunal from the date of filing of claim petition till its realization.
The said amount be paid within a period of three month s from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
Rest of conditions as imposed by learned NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:6169 4 MA-250-2016 Claims Tribunal shall remain intact.

8. If the enhanced amount of compensation is in excess to the valuation of appeal, the difference of the Court fee (if not already paid) shall be deposited by the appellants- claimants within a period of one month and proof thereof, shall be submitted before the Registry.
Thereafter, the Registry shall issue the certified copy of the order passed today.
9. In view of above, miscellaneous appeal filed by the appellants- claimants stands disposed of.
With the aforesaid, appeal stands disposed off.

(PREM NARAYAN SINGH) JUDGE amit Smt. Mankunwarbai vs Preetamsingh @ Raja on 7 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31032669/
